fields.name: logoImage
fields.label: Custom Logo Image
fields.description: Optional. Leave blank to keep the default Witherspoon Home Care logo mark. If you upload an image here, it replaces the logo everywhere on the site (header and footer). Keep it under 1MB, a small square logo, ideally 200x200px or larger, works best.

fields.name: tagline
fields.label: Tagline
fields.description: Short phrase shown under the logo in the footer, and used as the page preview text when the site is shared on social media.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone Number
fields.description: Format: 336-842-9744. Shown across the whole site.

fields.name: primaryCity
fields.label: Main City
fields.description: The largest city in your service area (currently Winston-Salem). Mentioned in a few places alongside the county list.

fields.name: serviceCounties
fields.label: Counties Served
fields.description: One entry per county (just the name, e.g. "Forsyth", not "Forsyth County"). Shown as a list in the footer and on the homepage's "Areas We Serve" section.

fields.name: address
fields.label: Office Address
fields.description: Shown in the footer and on the Contact page, and used for local search results (Google Maps, etc.). Leave the Street Address blank to hide the address everywhere it's shown.

fields.name: street
fields.label: Street Address
fields.description: e.g. "214 E. Mountain Street, Ste. 100"

fields.name: state
fields.label: State
fields.description: Two-letter abbreviation, e.g. NC

fields.name: heroHeadline
fields.label: Hero Headline
fields.description: The big headline on the homepage. The last part after the final space is shown in pink; see "Hero Headline Accent" below to control exactly where the pink starts.

fields.name: heroHeadlineAccent
fields.label: Hero Headline (Pink Part)
fields.description: The words from the headline above that should be highlighted in pink, e.g. "Like Home". Must match the end of the Hero Headline exactly.

fields.name: heroSubheadline
fields.label: Hero Subheadline
fields.description: The sentence under the big headline.

fields.name: heroButtonText
fields.label: Hero Button Text
fields.description: The gold button on the homepage hero. Keep this short (see warning below).

fields.name: heroVideoUrl
fields.label: Hero Video Link
fields.description: Optional. Paste a link to a video you've uploaded elsewhere (a YouTube "Unlisted" video works well, or a direct video file link from a service like Cloudinary). Leave this blank to keep the current default video.

fields.name: heroPoster
fields.label: Hero Preview Photo
fields.description: The still photo shown while the video loads, and instead of the video for visitors with motion-reduction turned on. This also becomes the preview image when the site is shared on social media. Keep it under 5MB so the page stays fast to load; a wide (landscape) photo works best here.

fields.name: testimonialsTeaser
fields.label: Testimonials Teaser Text
fields.description: Short paragraph inviting visitors to read testimonials, shown above a link to the Testimonials page.

fields.name: storyText
fields.label: "Our Story" Text
fields.description: Your founder/owner story. This is one of the most persuasive things families read, worth writing in your own voice.

fields.name: founderPhoto
fields.label: Founder Photo
fields.description: Optional photo shown next to your story. Keep it under 5MB; a square, close-up portrait works best (it's displayed in a circle).

fields.name: hiringIntro
fields.label: "How We Choose Our Caregivers" Intro Text

fields.name: hiringSteps
fields.label: Hiring Process Steps
fields.description: One line per step, shown as a checklist.

fields.name: services
fields.label: Services
fields.description: Use "Add" below to add a new service, the drag handle to reorder them, or the trash icon to remove one.

fields.name: tagline
fields.label: Short Tagline
fields.description: A one-line hook shown under the title, e.g. "So they're never alone or at risk."

fields.name: testimonials
fields.label: Testimonials
fields.description: Use "Add" to add a new family's testimonial, or the trash icon to remove one. If this list is empty, the page shows a friendly placeholder instead.

fields.name: author
fields.label: Author
fields.description: Use a first name and last initial for privacy, e.g. "Linda R."

fields.name: openingsNote
fields.label: Current Openings Note
fields.description: Optional. List specific open positions here, or leave blank to just say you're always hiring.

fields.name: pageHeading
fields.label: Page Heading
fields.description: Phone number and email address are edited under Site Settings, not here, since they're shared with the header and footer.

fields.name: hoursIntro
fields.label: Hours Intro Line
fields.description: Short line introducing the hours below, e.g. "Care coordination and scheduling support is available:"

fields.name: weekdayHours
fields.label: Weekday Hours
fields.description: e.g. "Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM EST"

fields.name: weekendHours
fields.label: Weekend Hours
fields.description: e.g. "Saturday – Sunday, by appointment only"

fields.name: hoursNote
fields.label: Hours Note
fields.description: Short closing line, e.g. "Call or email anytime and we'll get back to you promptly."

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
